tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: :rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus zab mo gter gyi mdzod las: rig 'dzin rgyun gyi phrin las bzhugs: :
rtsa gsum yongs rdzogs lha la 'dud:

rig 'dzin mchog gi sgrub pa yi: rgyun gyi rnal 'byor snying po ni: dbang thob dam ldan rnal 'byor pas: bkra shis byin chags sgrub khang du: phyi nang 'du 'dzi'i bya ba btang: sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams dang: snod ldan bla ma'i gtor chen bsham: phyi nang 'byor pa tshogs su spungs: dad dang 'byor pa mos gus kyis: rig 'dzin go 'phang mchog bsgrub phyir: sngon dngos rjes kyi 'jug par bya: sa ma ya: sngon 'gro'i dang po rgyud sbyong ni:

na mo: bdag dang mkha' khyab sems can ma lus kun: dus 'di nas bzung byang chub ma thob bar: bde gshegs yongs rdzogs rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lhar: sgo gsum rtse gcig gus pas skyabs su mchi: ho: mar gyur khams gsum rigs drug 'gro ba la: tshad med byams dang snying rje chen po'i blos: sku gsum go 'phang mchog la 'god pa'i phyir: rig 'dzin bla ma bsgrub par sems bskyed do:
gnyis pa 'gal rkyen bsal ba ni:
hūm̐: gsang sngags sgrub la blta bar mi dbang ba'i: mi dang mi min log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs: khro rgyal 'bar ba'i bka' las ma 'da' bar: rang rang so so'i gnas su bde bar dengs:
drag sngags brjod cing thun gyis gzir:

hūm̐ hrī: bla ma rig 'dzin byin rlabs sprin phung 'khrigs: yi dam lha tshogs srung ba'i gur du gtams: mkha' 'gro chos skyong mtshams kyi phrin las mdzad: bgegs dang bar chad 'jug pa'i skabs med gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī badz+ra rak+ṣa bh+rūm̐:
gsum pa mthun rkyen spel ba ni:

hūm̐ hrī: sku gsum dag pa'i zhing khams rab 'byams nas: dgongs brda snyan brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma dang: yi dam lha dang mkha' 'gro dam can gyis: gnas 'dir byin phob mthu rtsal dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba sa ma ya dz+nyā na ā bai sha ya a ā: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: stong pa'i ngang las gnas yul rdo rje'i zhing: phyi nang gsang mchod kun bzang rol pa'i rgyan: bde ba chen po'i longs spyod bsam mi khyab: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: oṃ sarba pū dza me gha sa ma ye āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta ma hā su kha pū dza āḥhūm̐:
sa ma ya: gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i las rim la: dang po dkyil 'khor sgrub pa ni:

a: 'od gsal de bzhin nyid dbyings ye shes las: zung 'jug dmigs med kun snang snying rje'i gdangs: sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyu mchog yi ge hrī: rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings su 'ja' ltar shar: de las bde chen 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis: snod bcud gzung 'dzin bag chags stong par sbyangs: stong gsal ngang las 'byung ba rim brtsegs steng: rdo rje'i srung 'khor nor bu'i gzhal med khang: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi yis brjid: ye shes yon tan rang snang rgyan du rdzogs: byang chub phyogs kyi pho brang chen po'i dbus: rin chen zur brgyad pad+ma nyi zla'i steng: hrīḥyig yongs gyur dkyil 'khor gtso bo mchog: rtsa gsum kun 'dus pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: bde stong dkar dmar mdangs ldan bcu drug nyams: ye shes rab rgyas zhi 'dzum khro bo'i tshul: theg gsum yongs rdzogs gsang phod chos gos dang: za 'og ber gsol dar dang rin chen brgyan: dbang bzhi'i mthar son rdo rje thod bum dang: kha ṭ+wāṃ g.yon 'khril pad+ma mthong grol gsol: sku dang zhing khams rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag che: 'ja' zer 'od phung thig le'i klong na bzhugs: de yi spyi bor pad sdong nyi zla'i steng: dbus su gsang bdag mthing gsal rdor dril 'chang: g.yas su 'jam dpal ral gri glegs bam ser: g.yon du spyan gzigs mchog sbyin pad+ma dkar: dar dang rin chen rgyan mdzes phyed skyil rol:

shar du yi dam dbang thob dga' rab rje: dkar gsal sa gnon mnyam gzhag sprul sku'i tshul: lho ru rgyud lung dbang thob rgyal po dza: mnyam gzhag glegs bam 'khor los sgyur ba'i chas: nub tu rig rtsal dbang thob shrī siṃ ha: dmar smug sdigs mdzub thod pa bcud bkang bsnams: byang du bshes gnyen dbang thob sangs rgyas gsang: chos gos gsum gsol chos 'chad phyag rgya 'ching: kun kyang dgyes 'dzum ye shes gzi byin 'bar: brda brgyud rig 'dzin tshom bu 'bum gyis bskor: de yi spyi bor pad+ma nyi zla'i steng: kun bzang mthing gsal mnyam gzhag yum dang 'khril: rigs lnga rigs brgya zhi khro rab 'byams lha: dgongs brgyud rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sprin phung 'phro: ye shes sgyu ma 'od skur lam mer bzhugs: hūm̐: gtso bo'i g.yas su dbyings yum man+dā ra: dkar dmar mdangs ldan mda' dar tshe bum bsnams: g.yon du bde chen ye shes mtsho rgyal ma: dga' bzhi'i nyams 'bar bdud rtsi'i ban+dha 'dzin: phyi rol rin chen zur brgyad 'od kyi klong: shar du yang dag rdo rje hūm̐ kā ra: thabs shes zung 'jug rdor dril thugs kar bsnol: lho ru 'jam dpal khrag 'thung bshes gnyen rtsal: 'khor 'das zil gnon be con sdigs mdzub sgreng: nub tu rta mchog rol pa nā gardzu: khams gsum dbang sdud 'khar gsil lhung bzed 'chang: byang du rdo rje gzhon nu pra hasti:

srid pa thal 'byin rgya gram phur bu gdengs: shar lhor mngon rdzogs dha na saṃskṛta: rtsa rlung dbang thob rnge'u chung thod khrag bsnams: lho nub dpal chen che mchog bi ma la: snang srid bdud rtsi dbyings kyi ban+dhar bskyil: nub byang gsang bdag gu h+ya tsan+d+ra ni: dregs tshogs gzir gnon lcags kyu zhags pa 'phen: byang shar stobs ldan shān+tiṃ gar+bha che: mngon spyod thog 'beb dmod pa'i gri gug gdengs: kun kyang zhabs gnyis 'dor stabs khro 'dzum nyams: gsang gos snam sbyar pad+ma'i mnyen zhu gsol: rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang bye ba 'bum sde'i dbus: lha dang dbyer med 'od skur lam mer bzhugs: hūm̐: de yi phyi rim pad+ma'i khor yug tu: bka' babs grub chen rje 'bangs nyi shu lnga: snyan brgyud bla ma bye ba 'bum sde'i dbus: brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab: sgyu 'phrul drwa ba chen po'i tshul du gsal: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor sgo bzhir pad nyi bdud bzhi'i steng: rigs bzhi'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yab yum rnams: dkar ser dmar ljang las bzhi'i nyams 'gyur rdzogs: rigs kyi phyag mtshan thod pa khrag bkang rol: dar dang rin chen dur khrod chas kyis brjid: ye shes me phung 'bar ba'i klong na 'gying: gzhan yang steng 'og bar mtshams thams cad du: rig 'dzin slob dpon yi dam dkyil 'khor lha: mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha gter bdag tshogs:

mdangs gsal ma 'gag rol pa'i gnas gsum du: 'bru gsum rgyas btab mi phyed rdo rje'i dngos: bde chen dbang thob rigs lnga'i cod pan 'chang: sku dang ye shes dbyer med phyag rgyar bzhengs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐ oṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: sarba ta thā ga ta āt+ma ko3 haṃ: hūm̐ hrī: rang byung sku gsum zhing khams rgya mtsho dang: 'og min pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas: bde gshegs kun 'dus o rgyan thod phreng rtsal: sku gsum bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las byin chen phob: phyi nang gsang ba don gyi dbang bzhi skur: bde chen mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī sarba maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdza: hūm̐ hrī: las kyi phyag rgyas spyan drangs ye shes pa: dam tshig phyag rgya'i rten dang dbyer med thim: chos kyi phyag rgya'i yi ge'i 'od zer gyis: phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du brtan par bzhugs: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa ma ya dz+nyā na tiṣ+ṭha lhan:
gnyis pa mchod pa'i las rim ni:

na mo: skye 'gag 'gyur med rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i tshogs: rang byung thugs rje'i skur bzhengs yi dam lha: yid bzhin phrin las mchog stsol dhā ki nī: rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: oṃ āḥhūm̐: kun bzang mchod sprin nyer spyod 'dod yon gter: sman gtor rak+ta sbyor sgrol bde ba ches: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rtag tu mchod: dbang skur byin rlobs ye shes dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ pūṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai bid+yā shab+da pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pra tīts+tsha swā hā: pañtsa a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta ga ṇa ma hā su kha pū dza ho: hūm̐ hrī: brgyud gsum bla ma byin rlabs 'byung ba'i gnas: yi dam lha tshogs dngos grub gter gyi mdzod: gang 'dul las mdzad dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: rtsa gsum yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod:
gsum pa bsnyen cing sgrub pa ni:

hūm̐ hrī: rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang bla ma rtsa gsum lha: dgyes pa'i skur bzhengs sngags kyi dzap dbyangs sgrog: ye shes chen po'i thugs rje'i gzi byin skyed: dgongs pas byin rlobs dbang dang dngos grub stsol:
zhes bskul bsnyen pa'i ting 'dzin gsal:

dgongs brgyud bla ma'i thugs kar rdo rje'i sbubs: hūm̐ mthar sngags phreng 'khor ba'i 'od zer sprin: bdag la thim pas rtog sgrib bag chags dag: ye shes chen po'i byin rlabs rgyud la smin: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐:
ye shes smin phyir bzhi 'bum bzla: nye bar bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i phyir:

dkyil 'khor gtso mchog pad+ma thod phreng gi: thugs kar rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐ gi mthar: sngags phreng 'khor ba'i zer gyis rgyal ba mchod: rtsa gsum byin rlabs dngos grub bdag la thim: sdig sgrib kun zhi rig rtsal nyams rtogs rgyas: snang ba dbang 'dus gzung 'dzin dgra bgegs bcom: mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med pa'i: dgongs pa mi g.yo 'od gsal thig ler 'khyil: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐:
'bum phrag bcu gnyis nye bar bsnyen:

slar yang sngags kyi 'od zer kun tu khyab: rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang rgyud bskul nus pa'i byin: tshur 'dus bdag thim dbang bzhi'i chu bos smin: ye shes klong dgu'i dgongs pa'i rtsal rdzogs gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐:
spyi dril 'bum phrag bzhi ru bzlas: sgrub pa chen pos las la sbyar:

khyab bdag mtsho skyes kun tu 'chang ba yi: gsang mtshan sngags kyi 'od zer gzi brjid kyis: dus gsum snyan brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskul: rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams mchod pas mnyes: rgyud gsum dregs pa'i dpung tshogs zil gyis mnan: dpag yas bde stong rol pa'i snang ba yis: tha mal snod bcud lha yi phyag rgyar sad: brtan g.yo'i sgra skad rdo rje'i sngags su sgrog: dran rtog dbyings rig dbyer med thig le'i ngang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub thob par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbadz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal dhe ba dhā ki nī badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ ā:
'bum phrag bzhi yis ye shes thob:

slar yang sngags kyi 'od zer snang ba yis: rigs bzhi'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i thugs rgyud bskul: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las mtha' yas pas: gang 'dul 'gro ba sgrol ba'i mthu thob gyur: ra tsa hri ya ha ri ni sa shān+tiṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ bā shaṃ mā ra ya phaṭa:
dus gnad sbyar te ci rigs bzla: thun mthar mchod bstod bzod par gsol: ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang yang blang:

oṃ āḥhūm̐: rtsa ba'i bla ma o rgyan rin po che: brgyud gsum rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i lha tshogs kyis: bdag rgyud sgrib gnyis bag chags yongs sbyangs nas: dbang skur byin rlobs dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: bskul zhing bsnyen pas lha tshogs thams cad kyi: thugs ka'i 'od zer lcags kyus dbang gi lha: nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs dgyes bzhin du: mchod pa'i rnam rol me tog char 'beb bzhin: phyi yi dbang bskur sgrib pa'i bag chags bkrus: nang gi dbang bskur ye shes rgyud la smin: sgrub pa'i dbang bskur chos kyi mdzod chen brdol: zab mo'i dbang bskur lhan skyes mngon du gyur: lha dang bdag nyid dbyer med 'od gsal ngang: rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang dngos grub mchog thob gyur: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī kā ya wā ka tsit+ta dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñtsa āt+ma ko3 haṃḥ lha nyid rang la rang nyid lha: rang rig rtsa ba gsum du gnas: ye shes dbang bskur gdod nas rdzogs: ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du bzhag:
sa ma ya: gsum pa rjes kyi las rim la: tshogs mchod bya zhing dngos grub gsol: thun mtshams bya bar 'jug pa ste: dang po tshogs kyi mchod pa ni: dam tshig rdzas bshams bdud rtsis bsang:

raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: ye shes chen po'i cho 'phrul me rlung chus: dam tshig rdzas kyi mtshan 'dzin bsregs gtor bkrus: chos dbyings bhan+dhar snang srid bdud rtsi'i bcud: 'dod yon sprin phung nam mkha' gang bar gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrī: hūm̐ hrī: 'og min zhing dang nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul: dur khrod brgyad sogs rab 'byams zhing rnams nas: bla ma rtsa gsum chos srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs: longs spyod tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri bā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdza: hūm̐ hrī: bla med mchog gi dam tshig chen po'i rdzas: ye shes lnga ldan 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i sprin: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la mchod par 'bul: bzhes nas byin rlabs mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri bā ra ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pū dza ho: hūm̐ hrī: rmad byung gsang chen rol pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: phyi nang nyer spyod 'dod yon sprin ltar gtibs: sman gtor rak+ta tshogs mchod 'jig rten gang: rdo rje'i rig mas bde stong glu gar sgyur: snang srid gzhir bzhengs ye shes chen po 'dis: brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs dam bskang: khyab bdag pad+ma thod phreng thugs dam bskang: sprul pa'i rje 'bangs lo paṇa thugs dam bskang: yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang:
dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong thugs dam bskang: thugs dam bskang ngo nyams chag bzod par bzhes: dag cing tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol:
yi ge brgya pa ci nus brjod:

hūm̐ hūm̐: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kun: zhal zas tshogs kyi 'du bar bkug cing bstim: ye shes chen po'i mtshon gyis dbyings su sgrol: rtsa gsum bde chen dgyes pa'i zhal du sbyor: sarba sha trūn bigh+nān dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: mā ra ya phaṭa: ta na ga ṇa pū dza ho:
nang ltar lus kyi dkyil 'khor mchod:

ho: phung khams skye mched zhi khro rab 'byams lha: rtsa khams brgyud gsum rig 'dzin dhā ki'i tshogs: dgyes mchod rdo rje bde ba'i tshogs la rol: bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs shog: ma hā pū dza a la la ho: oṃ hūm̐: lha sngags ye shes mi phyed pa: rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pas: kha sbyor bde ba'i sgra dbyangs len: bde mchog sgyu ma'i gar gyis rol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā dz+nyā na te te hūm̐: te na te te hūm̐: ma hā su kha gīrti ho: 'a a sa sha ma ha a nu rā ga dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: a ti bi shud+dha a haṃ:
gsang ba snyoms 'jug bde chen bskyed:

ho: snang stong lha sngags bde ba'i sgyu rtsal gyis: lhan skyes ye shes rgyud la brtan pa'i phyir: rjes chags dga' bzhi'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'beb: 'pho med bde chen ye shes gzi brjid 'bar: oṃ pad+ma badz+ra man+dā ra hūm̐ āḥ a nu rā ga dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: ma hā su kha dz+nyā na a haṃ:
rig stong gnyug ma'i dgongs pa bskyang: tha ma lhag ma'i dam tshig sbyin:

oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho: hriṃ hriṃ pheṃ pheṃ: ye shes 'jig rten las kyi lhag sdud tshogs: 'dir gshegs 'dod yon rgyan gyi lhag gtor bzhes: bar chad kun sol mthun rkyen yid bzhin sgrubs: bcol pa'i las kun myur du 'grub par mdzod: u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi: ho: phyi nang gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: dam tshig chen po'i longs spyod phul ba yis: bdag gzhan mkha' khyab 'gro ba ma lus kun: ye shes dkyil 'khor gcig tu 'grub par shog:
brgyud gsum srung ma'i tshogs rnams la: gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las gsol:

oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho: hūm̐: rdo rje srin po ma ning stobs po che: rgyud gsum dregs tshogs rgya mtsho'i 'khor bcas kun: he ru ka yi dam tshig 'du bar gshegs: mchod bzhes dam skongs bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la sarba dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdza: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pād+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai bid+yā shab+da pū dza ho: pañtsa a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta khā hi: hūm̐ hrī: bzhengs shig rtsa gsum chos srung rab 'byams kun: 'od gsal dbyings las ye shes skur bzhengs la: byin rlobs dbang skur dngos grub bstsal du gsol: rnam bzhi'i las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: hūm̐ bh+yo: sngon tshe dgongs brgyud bder gshegs zhi khro dang: bar du brda brgyud rig 'dzin tshom bur bcas: tha ma snyan brgyud grub pa'i tshogs rnams kyis: bka' bsgos dam bzhag rgyud gsum dregs pa rnams: ye shes rol pa rgyan gyi mchod gtor bzhes: gdug can bsgral pa'i sha khrag tshogs su rol: dza gad skyems phud btung bas gzi byin skyed: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi: phyi nang bdud bzhi'i bar chad dbyings su zlog: 'khor srung rgyud spel sdang ba'i dgra bgegs thul: zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod la sogs pa: bcol pa'i las kun myur du 'grub par mdzod: sarba dhārma pā la sa ma ya karma ku ru ho:
bshal chu'i bdud rtsi'i brtan ma mchod:

bh+yo: 'jig rten bod khams skyong ba'i g.yar dam can: bdud dang gnod sbyin sman mo brtan ma'i tshogs: dam rdzas gtor ma'i bshal chu 'di bzhes la: gangs can mtha' dbus bde ba'i phrin las mdzod: ma ma dhā ki nī hrīṃ hrīṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi:
las 'jug rdo rje'i bro yis bsdu:

hūm̐: rtsa gsum dbang drag rol pa'i dkyil 'khor du: bar chad dam sri'i dpung tshogs sde dang bcas: rdo rje lhun po ri rab 'og tu mnan: ye shes rol pa'i bro yis rgyas gdab bo: sarba sha trūn bigh+nān s+t+waṃ bha ya hūm̐ hūm̐:
gnyis pa dngos grub gsol ba ni:

hūm̐ hrī: rtsa gsum lha tshogs dngos grub gter gyi mdzod: bsnyen cing bsgrubs pas thugs dam rgyud bskul na: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las byin chen po: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub ma lus stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐:
gtang rag 'bul zhing nongs pa bshags: gsum pa thun mtshams bya ba'i phyir: rtag chad mtha' bsal bsngo smon dang: shis pa brjod pas mthar dbyung ngo:

a: rig rtsal rol pa bla ma'i dkyil 'khor lha: gdod nas rnam dag 'od gsal dbyings su thim: slar yang 'chi med pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: zung 'jug sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i phyag rgyar bzhengs: oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru kā ya wā ka tsit+ta āt+ma ko3 haṃ: ho: dge ba 'dis mtshon dus gsum bsod nams tshogs: ye shes chen po chos kyi dbyings su bsngo: bdag gzhan mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus kun: rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i go 'phang myur thob shog: oṃ: rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang bla ma'i byin rlabs dang: yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong bden pa'i mthus: bar chad kun zhi bsam don lhun gyis grub: sku bzhi'i go 'phang 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog:

ces brjod dga' ba'i nyams bskyang zhing: lha sngags ye shes rol pa'i ngang: bsod nams tshogs chen gong du spel: byin rlabs mos gus lam du khyer: sa ma ya: rig 'dzin mchog gi sgrub pa yi: rnal 'byor rgyun gyi phrin las tshul: kha tshang don 'dril byin rlabs myur: skal ldan yongs kyi dpal du shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: rgya rgya rgya: kha thaṃ: gu h+ya: 'chi med bstan gnyis g.yung drung gling pas lha mdo 'bur mo bde chen pad+ma bkod nas dngos grub tu thob pa'o// //
